title: Closure review — T9 (retrospective, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Closure review — T9 TOGAF ADM capability (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Outcome vs acceptance

T9's §12 gate asks that an architecture project pass Preliminary and A–F with each phase's mandatory artefacts approved and its contract live; that a phase missing a mandatory artefact be refused; that a delivery project without a live contract be refused at design; that a compliance review record one level and a waiver name its owner and review date; and that an H review produce exactly one change or kata. Clause one holds: `togaf_architecture_phases.rs::phases_a_to_f_pass_in_order` and the artefact and capability suites prove the approved-artefact and live-contract path. Clause two holds: `::a_draft_artefact_refuses_the_contract`. Clause three holds: `togaf_delivery_design_gate.rs::a_delivery_project_without_a_contract_cannot_pass_design` and `::a_superseded_contract_refuses_design`. Clause four holds: `architecture_compliance.rs::one_level_and_a_dated_waiver`. Clause five does not: the plan's `togaf_h_change.rs::a_systemic_finding_produces_a_kata_candidate` is absent at HEAD and v1-p81-6 records that exactly-one is not enforced.

## Evidence

`acceptance/programme/T9.toml` is the project's manifest. `docs/evidence/v1-conformance-findings.json` carries the twelve T9 rows: six resolved at `92e6b223` and six open. The test files and function names listed in the Phase-G findings were confirmed to exist at HEAD; no test was executed by this authoring pass. The console and seed checks exist but were not run. The delivery commits are `c8204432` and `ddf489ad`.

## Open items

- v1-p81-4 (P1) — a draft Board can govern with an empty charter. Owned by T9.
- v1-p81-5 (P1) — untyped or unprojected artefacts and links with no tenant/project consistency. Owned by T9.
- v1-p81-6 (P2) — Phase H enforces existence, not exactly one typed outcome; the plan's systemic-finding test is absent. Owned by T9.
- v1-w2a-3 (P1) — profile adoption accepts any UUID as its board decision. Owned by T9.
- v1-w2a-4 (P1) — `contracts_request` can retire another project's live contract. Owned by T9.
- v1-w2a-6 (P2) — `phase_progress` accepts draft artefacts and superseded contracts. Owned by T9.

None is waived.

## Decision

Close T9 on the programme's P0-only product gate: no open P0 finding remains. Requested by `conveyor-e2e` and decided by the distinct approver `conveyor-approver` under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`; the requester is not the approver. The six open items are carried as dated packages and must be disposed by a recorded decision at the programme's viability review if still open. This review is retrospective and does not attest contemporaneous intent.
